title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(袴田佳宏研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Hakamada Yoshihiro)
educationalGoal: In modern society, technological development based on life science is expected. In recent years, microorganisms have become widely used in the fields of pharmaceuticals, environmental protection, waste recycling, material production, energy, and food. Students are required to acquire microbial knowledge and related technologies independently. In the Nebaaru project, students can learn the importance of regional collaboration.
advice: The research themes in Project design III are listed below. Students are required to think and act independently. Students will acquire knowledge and techniques for problem solving through PD III activities. 1. Utilization of Bacillus natto (application for industry) -Tyrisinase inhibitor, LDH inhibitor, Production of Natto, Screening of Bacillus natto 2.Bioethnol production from Komb using marine microorganisms.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of biology, chemistry, physics, and statistics Basic experimental techniques Safety first

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand and manipulate life phenomena at the molecular and cellular level.
Ability to perform basic operations on proteins and biomolecules.
Ability to explain human senses and actions, and overall brain functions.
Ability to take basic measurements of human and biological senses, actions and brain functions.
Ability to create presentations and reports based on logical considerations.
